verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents a native subscription analytics page that lets you 'monitor overall performance at a glance' and benchmark metrics against similar Stripe businesses, so the analytics come from billing data rather than a BI export. However, the evidence never names MRR, churn, cohort retention, or LTV. An older community comment says Stripe lacked analytics comparable to Recurly; that lowers confidence but is not a concrete contradiction of the current docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MRR, churn, cohort retention and LTV metrics, details on how they are computed, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export
